immediately make more money. Let's say
we'll take this book. I could raise the

of the book or I could figure out what I

negotiate better rates on my shipping.
Number three is that you can have
upsells. Instead of being a digital
book, I could upsell a hard version of
this book. The downsell here is the
reverse of the upsell. If people can't
afford my hardback, then I say why don't
you have one of my digital copies, which
is cheaper. You can also have
cross-sells. I would sell a second book
that was different than the original
book. You can add in financing so that
people could pay for this book up front.

collect payment. You know what? You can
have a payment plan and you can pay as
long as you want, but we don't start
working until you pay off everything.
You can absolutely do this with any
business. It's actually harder with
physical products than it is with
services.
